records.text: Intervention effect. Base system: HfMoTaTiZr refractory high entropy alloy (RHEA). Intervention: Addition of 4.2 at% Cr to the nominal composition. Processing: Vacuum arc melting in an inert gas atmosphere, re-melted at least 5 times. Test conditions: Room temperature. Structure change: Formation of a Laves phase (Cr, Mo)2(Hf, Ti, Zr) in addition to the single-phase BCC structure; Laves phase forms a continuous reticulated inter-dendritic framework with a volume fraction of 3.8%. Property change: Hardness increased from 460.1 Hv 0.3 to 535.8 Hv 0.3 (56.96% higher); Yield strength increased from 1543.1 ± 40.9 MPa to 1750.6 ± 80.3 MPa (207.5 MPa higher); Fracture strain increased from 11.6 ± 4.0% to 14.0 ± 2.9% (20.6% higher). Mechanism: Solid solution hardening due to Cr dissolution in BCC phase and lattice distortion; presence of hard intermetallic Laves phase; reticulated structure of Laves phase hinders crack propagation and compensates for plasticity loss. Evidence: measured. Quote: "4.2 at% Cr addition into HfMoTaTiZr led to the formation of a Laves phase, in addition to the BCC phase."

item.structure_change: Lattice parameter of BCC phase decreased from 3.392 Å to 3.325 Å; Cr dissolved in BCC phase forming lattice distortions
item.attributed_mechanism: Solid solution hardening: Cr has the smallest atom radius, leading to more severe lattice distortions and more dislocations
quotes: The XRD-determined lattice parameters of HfMoTaTiZr and HfMoTaTiZrCr 0.5 are a HfMoTaTiZr = 3.392 Å and a HfMoTaTiZrCr 0.5 = 3.325 Å, respectively.
Thus, it is safe to conclude that a certain amount of Cr was dissolved in the BCC phase in HfMoTaTiZr and extra Cr reacted with HfMoTaTiZr to form the Laves phase.

Thus, incorporating Cr into the existing BCC unit cell will lead to more severe lattice distortions and more dislocations, i.e. , solid solution hardening, which effectively promotes the hardness and strength of HfMoTaTiZr.

Evidence: measured. Quote: "The XRD-determined lattice parameters of HfMoTaTiZr and HfMoTaTiZrCr 0.5 are a HfMoTaTiZr = 3.392 Å and a HfMoTaTiZrCr 0.5 = 3.325 Å, respectively."

item.structure_change: Formation of a hard intermetallic Laves phase with a reticulated structure surrounding elliptical dendrites
item.property_change: Fracture strain improved by 20.6% despite the presence of a brittle phase
item.attributed_mechanism: The reticulated structure of the Laves phase hinders crack propagation during deformation, decreasing the quantity and size of cracks
quotes: In contrast to HfMoTaTiZr, the elliptical dendrites in HfMoTaTiZrCr 0.5 alloy are surrounded by a continuous reticulated inter-dendritic framework.
However, in the as-cast HfMoTaTiZrCr 0.5 , the Laves phase is connected and forms a reticulated structure.
During deformation, the extension of cracks was impeded by the reticulated structure of the Laves phase, which decreases the quantity and size of cracks and was beneficial to the plasticity.

item.test_conditions: Room temperature compression tests (0.008 mm s−1 ram speed)
item.structure_change: Transition from intergranular/cleavage fracture to quasi-cleavage in BCC grains and ductile dimple fracture in Laves phase
item.attributed_mechanism: Ductile fracture observed in Laves phase grains indicates plastic deformation; reticulated structure impedes crack extension
quotes: In contrast, HfMoTaTiZrCr 0.5 RHEA shows a quasi-cleavage fracture surface at BCC grains.
